name: Oohara Kurou
source:
Kurou is a friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] and usually help him to understand his feelings toward the girl he love ( one of the main heroine ).

[spoiler]He gives to [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] his important collection of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pornographic_film]AVs[/url] and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pornographic_magazine]H magazines[/url] by male solidarity and because sharing is caring.[/spoiler]
